instruction: Use VLC to watch the Paramount+ series 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' from your subscription.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Paramount+ uses DRM protection (Widevine) on all streaming content. VLC cannot bypass DRM encryption, making playback of Paramount+ content impossible.
